externalRealVisualGuideline.principle: One or two strong real visual moments are preferred over generic stock filler; native UI remains the base layer.

WIKIMEDIA_COMMONS.notes: Use the discovery scout first for documentary/proof candidates. Search and file metadata come from Wikimedia Commons. Production candidates are license-filtered and deterministically ranked by relevance, resolution, crop suitability and rights status before local download. The exact file page must still be reviewed for attribution and non-copyright restrictions such as personality/privacy/trademark concerns where relevant.

GITHUB_RAW.notes: No repository-wide license guessing. The manifest must explicitly pin the commit and license evidence.
